parties: Ester Industries Limited; Ayush Vardhan Singhania
headline: Ester Industries: SEBI Regulation 10(5) Disclosure of Substantial Acquisition filed by Ayush Vardhan Singhania
sum: Ayush Vardhan Singhania has filed a Regulation 10(5) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Code with NSE, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares in Ester Industries Limited. The filing triggers mandatory disclosure obligations for acquirers crossing 5% shareholding thresholds.
implication: Regulation 10(5) disclosure is the initial formal notice to the exchange and company of a substantial acquisition event; the filing initiates the takeover timeline requiring detailed public disclosures, open-offer obligations if applicable, and CCI/board-level approvals depending on acquisition size and structure.
detail: Ayush Vardhan Singhania submitted a Regulation 10(5) disclosure to NSE on 14 August 2026 under the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is the initial statutory notice required when an acquirer's shareholding or control crosses prescribed thresholds (typically 5% for individual shareholders or 15% acquisition within a 90-day period). The specific acquisition amount, number of shares, and consideration are referenced in the filed disclosure document.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011
framework.note: Central regulation governing takeover requirements; Regulation 10(5) mandates disclosure of acquisition of 5% or more shares or voting rights, or acquisition of 15% shares within 90 days.

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992, Section 15I–15J
framework.note: Authority for SEBI to prescribe takeover regulations and enforce disclosure obligations.

framework.note: Govern voting rights, board composition, shareholder thresholds, and transfer restrictions relevant to substantial acquisition.

framework.ref: Companies Act, 2013, Section 89–92 (Conveyance of Beneficial Ownership)
framework.note: Defines substantial acquisition triggering disclosure requirements; integrates with SEBI takeover code.
Defines 'acquirer', 'target company', thresholds for disclosure (5% and 15% in 90 days), and mechanics of Regulation 10(5) filing.

framework.ref: NSE Listing Agreement / Stock Exchange Rules
framework.note: Procedural requirements for filing with exchange; deemed mandatory disclosure on BSE/NSE portal; timing and format specifications.

framework.ref: Competition Act, 2002, Section 5–6 (if acquisition triggers CCI thresholds)
framework.note: Acquisition exceeding prescribed asset/turnover thresholds may require CCI approval before completion (applies if value ≥ ₹2,000 crore asset or combined ≥ ₹6,000 crore turnover).
If acquirer is an insider or has prior knowledge of acquisition, trading restrictions and disclosure obligations apply.

Acquisition crosses 5% shareholding threshold or 15% acquisition within 90 days
Open offer obligation may be triggered if control passes to new acquirer
approvals: Possible CCI approval if acquisition value triggers thresholds

triggers.note: Mandatory disclosure when acquirer crosses 5% or acquires 15% within 90 days; filing with exchange within 4 working days of acquisition.

triggers.law: SEBI Takeover Code, Regulation 3(6) – Open Offer
triggers.note: If acquisition results in change of control or crosses 25%, acquirer may be obliged to make an open offer to public shareholders at floor price.
If transaction value/party size meets CCI thresholds, prior merger approval required before acquisition completion.
